## 👋 Client Finder Lite (free)
Finds local businesses on Google Maps and flags the ones with **no website**, which are perfect leads for web designers. You get a CSV with name, phone, rating and Maps link.

**Setup (5 min, see QUICKSTART.pdf):**
1. Create a Google API key with **Places API (New)** enabled.
2. In n8n create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `X-Goog-Api-Key`, Value = your key. Select it on *Search Google Maps*.
3. Activate/publish the workflow, open *Find Leads Form* and copy the Production URL.

Submit the form and your CSV downloads automatically.

## 🚀 Want the full Client Finder?
The paid version checks every website (speed, mobile, SSL, booking, chat...), scores each lead, writes a personalized pitch with Claude, saves everything to a Google Sheet CRM and puts ready-to-send drafts in your Gmail.

👉 https://YOUR-STORE.gumroad.com/l/client-finder
